name: Shadow theatre frame
looks: A decorative stage-curtain border hangs around every shot like a puppet theatre's proscenium. The scene inside is built from flat black silhouettes layered at different depths for parallax, against a soft gradient sky drifting slowly from one time of day to the next. A single rope hangs down one side, pulled to open the first shot and released to close the last.
build: The curtain is a fixed DOM frame layered above every scene for the whole runtime; each silhouette element is a flat shape at a fixed depth, parallax from each depth panning at its own slow rate; the sky gradient interpolates over the whole film's clock with a moon or sun on its own slow arc; the rope tweens out on open and back in on close.
sound: A soft fabric rustle as the curtain opens and closes, a quiet ambient bed under the whole film, no hard hits.
prompt: Frame the whole film in a decorative stage-curtain border, like a puppet theatre, with every scene built from flat black silhouettes at different depths against a slowly drifting gradient sky. Open with a curtain rope pulling back and close the same way, for a hand-made, storybook register.
